name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Income support to landholding farmer families, paid directly into their bank account.

eligibility_criteria.source_clause: Para 2.1 — All landholding farmers' families, which have cultivable land holding in their names, shall be eligible to get benefit under the scheme.
Para 2.1 — The cultivable land must be held in the name of the farmer family as per the land records of the State/UT.
Para 3 (Exclusions), (iv) — All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year are not eligible for benefit.
Para 3 (Exclusions), (iii) — All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government (excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D) are not eligible.

benefit_amount_or_type: ₹6,000 per year, paid in three instalments of ₹2,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer
apply_at: pmkisan.gov.in or nearest Common Service Centre

name: Ayushman Bharat — PM Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
description: Cashless hospital treatment cover for poor and vulnerable families, and for all senior citizens aged 70+.
source_document: AB PM-JAY eligibility guidelines (paraphrased; income limit is a demo proxy for SECC-2011 deprivation criteria)

any_of.source_clause: Beneficiary identification — Families identified as deprived under SECC-2011 criteria (represented in this demo as household annual income up to ₹5,00,000) are entitled to cover.
Expansion notified Oct 2024 — All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible irrespective of socio-economic status.

benefit_amount_or_type: Health cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for hospitalisation — cashless at empanelled hospitals
processing_time: Card issued same day at CSC / hospital Arogya Mitra desk
apply_at: beneficiary.nha.gov.in, Ayushman app, or empanelled hospital

name: Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Scholarship
description: Fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance for students from low-income families studying Class XI and above.
source_document: State post-matric scholarship guidelines (paraphrased; amounts simplified for demo)

eligibility_criteria.source_clause: Clause 2(a) — The student shall be a native of Tamil Nadu.
Clause 2(b) — The student shall be studying in a post-matriculation course (Class XI onwards, diploma, UG or PG) in a recognised institution.
Clause 2(c) — The annual income of parents/guardians from all sources shall not exceed ₹2,50,000.

benefit_amount_or_type: Full tuition + exam fee reimbursement and maintenance allowance (≈ ₹45,000 per year)
apply_at: State scholarship portal via your institution
conflict_clause: Demo rule — Welfare DBT Consolidation Order, Clause 4: a household may avail only one of the designated state-funded direct-benefit schemes (Post-Matric Scholarship, CM Housing Subsidy) in a financial year.

name: Tamil Nadu CM Pucca Housing Subsidy
description: One-time assistance for families living in kutcha houses (or houseless) to build a pucca house.
source_document: State rural housing scheme guidelines (paraphrased; amounts simplified for demo)

eligibility_criteria.source_clause: Section 3.1 — The beneficiary household shall be resident in Tamil Nadu.
Section 3.2 — The household shall be living in a kutcha house (thatched / mud walls) or be houseless.
Section 3.4 — Annual household income shall not exceed ₹3,00,000.

benefit_amount_or_type: One-time assistance of ₹3,50,000 released in stages as construction progresses
processing_time: Selection by Gram Sabha; first stage release in 3–6 months
conflict_clause: Demo rule — Welfare DBT Consolidation Order, Clause 4: a household may avail only one of the designated state-funded direct-benefit schemes (Post-Matric Scholarship, CM Housing Subsidy) in a financial year.
